description: Whitespace: clean messy scraped write-ups. html_strip -> trim -> normalised title(+tagline) fingerprint (dedupe_key) -> lang_ident_model_1 (falls back to the client's guess, then 'und') -> quality_flags -> ingested_at. Any processor failure reroutes the document to the quarantine index with ingest_error.

script.description: Trust lang_ident only when it is confident; otherwise keep the client's guess. Then derive quality flags (idempotent on re-index). too_short = pitch < 250 chars; YC one-liners are legitimately short (25% are < 250 chars), so for source=yc the bar is 60 chars.
script.source: if (ctx.tmp_lang != null && ctx.tmp_lang.predicted_value != null) { def p = ctx.tmp_lang.prediction_probability; if (p == null || p >= 0.5) { ctx.lang = ctx.tmp_lang.predicted_value; } } if (ctx.lang == null) { ctx.lang = 'und'; } if (ctx.quality_flags == null) { ctx.quality_flags = new ArrayList(); } else if (!(ctx.quality_flags instanceof List)) { def one = ctx.quality_flags; ctx.quality_flags = new ArrayList(); ctx.quality_flags.add(one); } int n = ctx.pitch == null ? 0 : ctx.pitch.length(); int minLen = 'yc'.equals(ctx.source) ? 60 : 250; if (n < minLen && !ctx.quality_flags.contains('too_short')) { ctx.quality_flags.add('too_short'); } if (ctx.lang != 'en' && ctx.lang != 'und' && !ctx.quality_flags.contains('non_english')) { ctx.quality_flags.add('non_english'); }
